locations.note: A 1984 prologue has teenage Lara exploring Angkor Wat with her mentor Werner Von Croy.
In late 1999 Lara takes the Amulet of Horus from the Tomb of Set and unleashes the god Set.
Beneath Karnak's temples Lara hunts the tomb of Semerkhet for clues to imprisoning Set.
Lara and Jean-Yves race Von Croy's men for the Armour of Horus in the buried ruins of Cleopatra's palace.
Von Croy holds Jean-Yves for ransom in a Cairo overrun by Set's forces.
Lara blasts her way past a giant serpent into the Citadel of Saladin.
The finale beneath the Great Pyramid: Lara begins the ritual to summon Horus, Set attacks, and she traps him under the pyramid.

routes.name: Lara and Set
routes.note: From the 1984 prologue at Angkor Wat to the binding of Set under the Great Pyramid.
